title: Log events of a Lambda function that match the error pattern

logGroup.description: The log group searched: the function's configured one, which several functions can share (then matches of other functions appear; the stream name says whose), else /aws/lambda/<name>

logGroupFound.description: false: the log group does not exist (the function was never invoked, or it was deleted); null: it could not be read (a scoped permission_denied error); true otherwise

pattern.description: The filter pattern that was searched

events.description: Oldest first (CloudWatch returns the earliest matches of the window first), at most maxLogEvents

message.description: The log text, scrubbed of credentials, cut to 1024 characters

truncated.description: The list is cut: more events matched than it holds (the newest are not shown; narrow since), or a later page timed out after these matched (a timeout error scoped logs)

messagesTruncated.description: Some message passed 1024 characters and was cut
